name: Jason N. Gross
title: Professor and Department Chair; Navigation Lab Director
department: Mechanical, Materials and Aerospace Engineering; Navigation Lab
fitReason: Specific learned semantic perception supports actual outdoor robot navigation, with current faculty and mentoring evidence.

physicalEvidence.status: Current-institution learned perception and real staged navigation verified; collaborative project
physicalEvidence.summary: The complete 2024 preprint, published at IROS 2025, trains YOLOv8 segmentation on hiking-trail images and fuses semantics with LiDAR geometry for traversability. A real Husky A200 with ZED2i, HDL32E and LIO-SAM is first teleoperated to build the map, then follows classical RRT*/FALCO planning through a grass detour around impassable trail hazards at WVU Arboretum. This is staged learned-perception-to-navigation, not an end-to-end learned motion policy or unassisted initial exploration. Quantitative weighting sweeps are Gazebo; the physical field demonstration is separate. Physical20 reflects collaborative WVU evidence with Yu Gu and the staged setup.
